# LedgerLoan — Home Loan EMI Planner

> Free Indian home loan calculator that models interest rate changes, annual EMI step-ups, pause windows, one-off prepayments, upfront fees, prepay-vs-invest comparisons, and what-if scenarios.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Full repayment planner with amortization schedule, KPI tiles, balance charts, upfront cost breakdown, prepay-vs-invest comparison, and what-if scenario analysis.
